evidence.quote: We ratified the async job contract

observations.why: The collective 'We ratified' enacts communal-sharing: a unified body ratifying as one, not a hierarchical command or proportional exchange.

evidence.quote:
the agent either polls the run or
gets the reaction piggybacked on a later call

observations.why: The two reciprocal paths — poll now or receive piggybacked later — frame an even, turn-taking exchange where the agent gets its result one way or another, matching rather than commanding or pricing.
